posts.cooked: Anyone is facing “PTY allocation request failed on channel 0” this error when try to ssh in sc-oppe?

posts.name: Johnson Philips
posts.cooked:
Yes - me too - from yesterday, for the OPPE VM
this is just now , see image below.

image530×459 8.45 KB

And my regular course VM was working until this morning 3am IST, just now I checked, it is not working as well, seems something changed at the remote host/server side,
it looks some global issue with the server/host key, not just one or two students problem.

@sayan @Subendu please do something urgently and advise so that we won’t have issues in the exam - also now we are not able to practice:

image852×479 13.9 KB

thanks for your prompt intervention asap.

PS:
note that all my times shown in screenshots are UAE times, add 1.5 hours to it for IST - so currently I’m sending this message update at 10:40am IST:

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
If you are

  • getting permission denied → please upload your public key to se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in and try again, it should come back to same page. If it says error creating user, just resubmit the key again.
  • If you are getting PTY allocation request failed it means your public key is working, you are all set for OPPE. You cannot access the VM though till OPPE starts.
  • Getting host identity changed, run ssh-keygen -R sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in and then retry.

posts.name: Johnson Philips
posts.cooked:
Thanks @sayan - my case is the second one - PTY allocation request failed - in which case my setup is good to go, I’ll try it after 6pm IST then.
thanks very much again!
